cli.error.auth: {brain} refused the key. Check it, or connect another brain.
cli.error.credits: {brain} is out of credits. Add some to your account, or choose another brain.
cli.error.rate_limit: {brain} is busy or your limit is reached. Wait a moment and try again.
cli.error.bad_request: {brain} didn’t accept the request. Try another version of this brain.
cli.error.not_found: {brain} couldn’t find this version. Pick another one.
cli.error.server: {brain} is having trouble. Try again in a moment.
cli.error.bad_response: {brain} sent an answer that couldn’t be read. Try again.
cli.notSync: {folder} isn’t a folder Sync keeps. Give the one you chose in Settings › Your data.
cli.noBrain: No brain can answer yet. Put its key in the environment, such as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or sign in to Claude Code.
cli.needsName: Name the brain that answers: --brain {provider}:<its name>.
cli.help.acp: {name} in your editor, on the folder Sync keeps.
cli.help.brain: --brain picks the brain, such as anthropic, openrouter or claudecode; its key comes from the environment.
cli.help.gateway: The gateway, for the services a browser can’t reach, such as Gmail or Slack.
cli.gateway.origin: Name the address you open in your browser, such as https://{domain}: --origin <address>.
cli.gateway.ready: The gateway answers at {address}. Name it in Settings › Connections.
